name: heat_transfer_fluid_properties
title: Heat-transfer fluids: MEG, Therminol VP-1/66 and oil properties (function library)
summary: Single EES PROCEDURE returning density, specific heat, thermal conductivity and dynamic viscosity of four heat-transfer/secondary fluids (monoethylene glycol, Therminol VP-1, Therminol 66, a constant-property thermal oil) against temperature by the empirical correlations of the source file; any other fluid name is routed to the built-in property functions with the (T, P) input pair.
language_features: built-in property calls inside a procedure

origin.notes: The file carries only the J. Lebrun laboratory licence tag; the S. Quoilin attribution follows the C-121 triage note (sources/thermo_models/README.md §8). Already in SI-°C-Pa-J: no unit conversion. Procedure renamed prop_htf -> prop_heat_transfer_fluid: the name prop_htf is already used by the copied blocks of CSL-0113 and CSL-0114 and function names must be unique across the library. The $bookmark directive (EES GUI tag) was removed. No equation was changed.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (therminol66 at T = 180 °C, 6 variables)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 6 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 21 (the demonstration calls of the other fluids). The correlations are recomputed identically: cp differs by 1.9e-10 (the stored EES value is rounded to 10 significant digits), mu by 3.3e-11, and rho, k, T, p are exact. The HEDH heat-transfer-fluid data sheet of the VP-1 branch (http://twt.mpei.ac.ru/TTHB/HEDH/HTF-VP1.PDF, cited in the source file) could not be reached from the import environment (no network access), so the sheet-value check of that branch is pending; its coefficients are transcribed unchanged from the source file.

related_external: HEDH heat-transfer-fluid data sheet Therminol VP-1: http://twt.mpei.ac.ru/TTHB/HEDH/HTF-VP1.PDF (cited in the source file)
